name: Mthr Melissa Dickinson
bio: Mother Melissa has been Curate at Emmanuel since June 2024. She grew up in London and worked in Communications before figuring out she wanted to become a priest. Her time at Emmanuel represents the final years of her training, so she is involved across many aspects of our worship and work. In particular, Melissa has helped to launch Forest Church and developed our Pastoral Care Team. She has a Masters in 'ecotheology' and is convinced that our Christian tradition provides us with resources for living well in God's Creation.
